landing.heroBody: GraphMind reads everything you upload, maps who and what is connected to what, and answers your questions using only what your own documents actually say — with a citation on every claim.
landing.noAnswerWithoutEvidence: No answer without evidence — if your documents don't support it, GraphMind says so.
landing.heroSampleAnswer: Priya Raman leads it, with Platform Engineering as the owning team.

upload.title: Upload anything
upload.body: Drop in PDFs, docs and notes. GraphMind extracts the text, chapter by chapter, and tracks every file through ingestion.

answers.title: Answers with receipts
answers.body: Every answer is grounded in your own documents and carries citation chips back to the exact chapter it came from. No evidence, no answer.

connections.title: See the connections
connections.body: People, organizations, projects, products and places are pulled out into a live knowledge graph you can explore — or read as a list.

add.title: Add your documents
add.body: Upload one file or a whole folder. Watch each one move from Uploaded to Ready.

ask.title: Ask in plain language
ask.body: Narrow the scope to the documents you care about, then just ask.

follow.title: Follow the evidence
follow.body: Open any citation to land on the source, or jump to the graph to see how it all connects.

landing.closingBody: Free to set up. Your library, your answers, your evidence.
